newsitem.title: USA: Transco files with FERC for gas expansion.
newsitem.headline: Transco files with FERC for gas expansion.

text.p: Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Corp (Transco) said Thursday it plans to file with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) to expand its natural gas mainline in Alabama and Georgia.

The 1998 Cherokee Expansion Project would provide annual firm transportation capacity from the interconnect between Transco's mainlines and Mobile Bay Lateral (Station 85) to delivery points upstream of Station 130 in Madison County, Ga.
The new transportation, if approved by FERC, would be available November 1, 1998.
Transco will hold an open season to accept firm gas nominations December 19 through January 20 for gas shipped on the section of their system that would include the expanded line.
The company said it could not say how much capacity would be added until after the open season.
Transco is a subsidiary of The Williams Cos.
